endsAt.description: When the poll closes for voting

subject.description: Reference to the post this poll is attached to. Inside a space this may be a space record uri (e.g. a forum thread) of the same space.

main.description: A poll record. Lives in the author's own repo, either as a public record (attached to a post via embed.external and indexed from the firehose) or inside an ATProto Space (permissioned data), where the AppView is told about it with tech.tokimeki.poll.notifySpaceWrite and reads it with a space credential.
